propositions: Focused prerequisite-consistency criterion must evaluate each direct dependency independently against the subject plan without mixing prerequisite material into general reviewer prompts.

Focused finder and verifier must route through the sole preloaded PlanRelationSnapshot, batch by stable lexicographic canonical ID, and emit schema-valid disposition records with no cross-prerequisite findings.

Focused Pass-2 verifier receives each authoritative prerequisite block and emits yes|no|na attribution; missing or incorrect attribution must prevent that prerequisite from producing blocking findings.
Any indeterminate prerequisite record must force top-level unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict regardless of general findings; concurrent DET blockers remain visible in the blocking array.

Singleton-baseline and packed-bin gold corpus evaluations must meet absolute recall≥0.90, false-acceptance≤0.10, coverage=1.0, attribution-error=0.0, with packed non-regression against pinned singleton metrics.
